화이트 인더스트리(White Industries)는 1978년 더그 화이: White Industries is a bicycle parts maker that Doug White started in 1978 in a spare room of his home in Inverness, Marin County, California. The first product was Peggers, a Velcro band that keeps your trouser leg out of the chain, and for nearly ten years it was the only one.
1980년대 말 재봉틀을 밀링 머신으로 바꾸면서 화이트 인더스트리는 기계: In the late 1980s the sewing machines gave way to milling machines, and White Industries became a machine shop. Today in Petaluma, Doug's son Alec White leads the company as CEO, designer and engineer, and more than 20 people machine and assemble hubs, cranks, chainrings, bottom brackets, headsets and freewheels in-house.
인버네스의 빈방에서 시작한 자전거 부품 회사: A parts maker that began in a spare room in Inverness

페탈루마 공장은 사무실과 재고실, 그리고 밀링 머신과 CNC가 쉼 없이: The Petaluma shop is split into an office, a stock room and a production floor where mills and CNC machines hum without pause. The broacher that cuts the teeth in freehub bodies is a messy job drenched in cutting oil, so everyone takes a turn, Doug and Alec included. When The Radavist visited in 2018, the impression was of an all-hands-on-deck shop.
새 기계를 들이기 전에는 지금의 공정부터 다시 뜯어봅니다. 그렇게 네 대: Before buying a new machine, they take the current process apart first. That is how freehub bodies went from four machines to one. Robot arms take the repetitive work so people can do what people do best. And customer questions, Alec insists, are always answered by a person.
알렉은 회사의 방식을 한마디로 적응하거나 사라지거나라고 말합니다. 50년: Alec sums up the company's approach as adapt or die. For nearly 50 years it has kept up with the industry without letting go of simple, serviceable design.
크랭크는 사각 알루미늄 소재에서 여러 공정을 거쳐 깎아 냅니다. 허브 쉘: Cranks are machined from square aluminum stock through a series of operations. Hub shells and bottom brackets have been drilled and engraved on the same machine for fifteen years.
아노다이징하는 부품은 모두 먼저 연마합니다. 그래야 색과 마감이 고르게: Every anodized part is polished first, which keeps the colour and finish consistent. Logos are machine-engraved before anodizing.
베어링은 엔듀로 실드 카트리지를 쓰고, 교체 부품과 베어링 설치 키트를: Bearings are Enduro sealed cartridges, and replacement parts and bearing install kits are sold separately. Parts made to be ridden for years and rebuilt.
허브 · 비비는 블랙, 블루, 골드, 퍼플, 폴리시 실버. 크랭크 캡과: Hubs and bottom brackets come in black, blue, gold, purple and polished silver. Crank caps, chainring nuts and headsets vary by product
기계공으로 시작해 자전거 가게 정비사, 프레임 빌더를 거쳐 부품을 만들기: From machinist to bike shop mechanic to framebuilder, and finally to making parts.
더그 화이트는 1960년대 말 샌프란시스코 공항의 유나이티드 항공에서 기: Doug White started out in the late 1960s as a machinist for United Airlines at SFO. In 1970 he moved to Marin County and joined the first class of the College of Marin's industrial arts program, where he met his lifelong collaborator Craig Mitchell. In 1971 he took over Craig's job at Sunshine Bicycle Center in Fairfax, and his career in the bike industry began.
1972년 손님 필 브라운과 함께 브라운 앤 화이트 사이클(Brown &: In 1972 he and customer Phil Brown founded Brown & White Cycles and built around 30 frames, and in 1976 he built himself a 20 inch wheel mountain bike for the trails of Inverness. That same year Craig used the same fixtures to build a 26 inch mountain bike frame for Charlie Kelly.
더그는 공식적으로는 은퇴했지만 지금도 공장에 나와 기계를 프로그래밍하고: Doug is officially retired but still comes in to program and fix the machines. Alec, who has been in the shop since he was four, is now CEO, designer and engineer, and carries on his father's love of machines and obsession with detail.

1992년 화이트 인더스트리는 약 260g의 Ti 카세트 리어 허브를 내: In 1992 White Industries released the Ti Cassette rear hub at around 260g, the lightest rear hub on the market, along with the Tracker front hub, whose oversized axle stiffened the flexy suspension forks of the day. The design has changed little in 30 years, and today's hubs carry it on.
리어 허브의 쉘은 6061-T6 알루미늄, 프리허브 바디는 6/4 티타늄: Rear hub shells are 6061-T6 aluminum and freehub bodies 6/4 titanium. Three steel pawls with stainless leaf springs engage a 48T drive ring every 7.5°, and four Enduro sealed bearings carry the load.
프리허브 바디는 6/4 티타늄입니다. 톱니는 브로칭 머신이 톱니 달린 막: The freehub body is 6/4 titanium. Its teeth are cut in one pass by a broacher that pulls a toothed rod through the ring.
48T 강철 드라이브 링과 폴 세 개. 빠르게 물리면서도 단순한 구조라: A 48T steel drive ring and three pawls. Quick engagement from a simple design that lasts and is easy to service.
시마노 HG 8~12단, 마이크로 스플라인, 스램 XD · XDR, 캄파: Shimano HG 8 to 12 speed, Micro Spline, SRAM XD and XDR, Campagnolo 9 to 12 speed, and Campagnolo N3W and Ekar. Swap just the body to change drivetrains.
QR과 스루 액슬은 액슬 키트로 바꿔 끼웁니다. 엔듀로 XD-15 세라믹: Switch between QR and thru-axle with an axle kit. An Enduro XD-15 ceramic bearing upgrade is available.
센터락 디스크 허브. 로드, 그래블, MTB, 투어링을 가리지 않는 화이: Center Lock disc hub. White Industries' most popular hub, at home on road, gravel, MTB and touring bikes.
ISO 6볼트 로터를 쓰는 디스크 허브. 높은 플랜지의 클래식한 모습으로: Disc hub for ISO 6-bolt rotors. A classic high flange look for mountain, gravel and touring.
림 브레이크 로드와 올로드, 그래블을 위한 가벼운 허브. 디스크 허브와: A light hub for rim brake road, all-road and gravel bikes, with the same freehub internals as the disc hubs.
1992년 Ti 허브의 직계. 낮은 무게와 간결한 모습으로 로드, 그래블: A direct descendant of the 1992 Ti hub. Light and clean, it suits road, gravel, touring and classic MTB.
브롬톤 4단을 위한 허브. 작은 바퀴의 높은 스포크 장력에 맞춰 플랜지: A hub for the Brompton 4-speed, with flange geometry reworked for the high spoke tension of small wheels.
하이 플랜지, 고광택, 창을 낸 플랜지, 청동 액슬 너트. 컵 앤 콘 조: High flanges, high polish, windows and bronze axle nuts, with cup-and-cone style adjustment on Enduro bearings.

화이트 인더스트리는 자사 허브로 짠 완성 휠도 만듭니다. 2023년에는: White Industries also builds complete wheels on its own hubs. In 2023 it acquired the Eugene, Oregon wheel brands Rolf Prima and Astral Cycling, which still run as separate brands.
루비워크샵에서는 프레임의 액슬 규격과 로터 방식, 구동계에 맞춰 허브를: At Rubi Workshop we choose the hub for your frame's axle standard, rotor mount and drivetrain, then match rims and spokes and build the wheels. For Bromptons and small-wheel bikes we recommend the MET hub.
MR30 크랭크는 미국산 2024-T365 알루미늄 사각 소재를 여러 공: MR30 cranks are machined from US-sourced 2024-T365 aluminum square stock through a series of operations. Arms and 30mm spindles alike are machined, finished and assembled in Petaluma.
공장 한쪽에는 더그가 10여 년 전 테일러 기타(Taylor Guitar: In one corner of the shop is a robot Doug bought from Taylor Guitars around a decade ago. It sat looking for a job until the MR30 cranks arrived, when Doug programmed it himself to polish crank arms. The person who used to polish by hand now runs it.
로드, 올로드, 엔듀런스, 그래블. 대형 브랜드 로드 크랭크를 그대로 대: Road, all-road, endurance and gravel. A narrow Q-factor that directly replaces the big brands' road cranks.
로드 체인라인에 MTB 암을 달아 Q 팩터와 체인스테이 사이 여유를 넓혔: MTB arms on a road chainline for a wider Q-factor and more chainstay clearance.
말 그대로 화이트 인더스트리의 산악자전거 크랭크. 68 · 73mm와 8: Simply put, a White Industries mountain bike crank. Fits 68 and 73mm, and 86 and 92mm BB shells.
73mm 비비 셸에 좁은 체인스테이를 가진 그래블 · 투어링 프레임을 위: A combination for gravel and touring frames with 73mm BB shells and narrower chainstays.
단순하고 튼튼하며 정비가 쉬운 스퀘어 테이퍼 크랭크도 계속 만듭니다. 로: Simple, durable and easy to service, square taper cranks are still in the line. The road crank takes VBC 2x chainrings, and the ENO crank is made for 1x TSR rings and single speed builds.
클래식 로드와 투어링, 싱글스피드 산악자전거처럼 스퀘어 테이퍼 비비를 쓰: They suit bikes with square taper bottom brackets, such as classic road, touring and single speed mountain bikes, and come in five colours.
1991년 시마노 XTR이 나오면서 화이트 인더스트리는 1978년 문을: When Shimano's XTR arrived in 1991, White Industries worried about closing its doors for the first time since 1978. What saved it was the single speed freewheel and the single speed mountain bike community that embraced it. The ENO freewheel and eccentric ENO hub came out of that era, and White Industries still makes single speed parts today.
체인링과 비비도 같은 공장에서 깎습니다. VBC 체인링은 볼트 서클을 바: Chainrings and bottom brackets are machined in the same shop. VBC chainrings vary the bolt circle so one outer ring takes several inner rings, and the bottom brackets carry 24, 29 and 30mm spindles on Enduro bearings.
싱글 16~22T, 더블 16/18 · 16/19 · 17/19 · 20: Singles from 16 to 22T, doubles in 16/18, 16/19, 17/19 and 20/22. Heat-treated S7 tool steel pawls, a 4130 steel driver, and fully rebuildable.
ENO 편심 허브는 축을 돌려 앞뒤로 20mm 움직이며 체인 장력을 맞춥: The eccentric ENO hub rotates its axle through 20mm of fore-aft travel to set chain tension, so even vertical dropout frames can run single speed or fixed gear.
가변 볼트 서클(Variable Bolt Circle). 바깥 링 하나에: Variable Bolt Circle. Pair up to five inner ring sizes with one outer ring and change your gearing without changing cranks.
화이트 인더스트리 30mm 스핀들 크랭크 전용 1x 체인링. 오프셋 링의: 1x chainrings for White Industries 30mm spindle cranks only. Choose from three chainlines by flipping the offset ring.
24mm 홀로테크 II, 29mm 스램 DUB, 30mm 스핀들. 68: 24mm Hollowtech II, 29mm SRAM DUB and 30mm spindles. 68 and 73mm shells, stainless angular contact or XD-15 ceramic bearings. 83g per pair for 30mm.
외장형과 내장형 T47, 압입식 PF86/92, 클래식 스퀘어 테이퍼 비: External and internal T47, press-fit PF86/92 and classic square taper bottom brackets, all machined in the same shop with Enduro bearings.

From a spare room in Inverness
to a two-generation factory.
재봉틀 두 대로 바짓단 밴드를 만들던 빈방에서, 20명이 넘는 사람이 일: From a spare room where two sewing machines made trouser bands to a Petaluma factory employing more than 20 people. Over nearly 50 years in which many parts makers disappeared, White Industries has adapted to change while holding on to making things in-house.
페어팩스의 선샤인 바이시클 센터에서 일하며 더그가 자전거 업계에 들어섭니: Doug joins the bike industry at Sunshine Bicycle Center in Fairfax.
He builds a 20 inch wheel mountain bike for the trails of Inverness.
집 빈방에서 재봉틀 두 대로 바짓단 밴드 페거스를 만들며 화이트 인더스트: White Industries begins with Peggers trouser bands, made on two sewing machines in a spare room. They sell to Raleigh and Schwinn.
재봉틀을 밀링 머신으로 바꾸고, 노바토로 옮겨 티타늄 스핀들 실드 비비와: Sewing machines give way to mills; in Novato the first MTB parts arrive, a sealed titanium spindle BB and the Limbo Spider.
Shimano XTR arrives, and for the first time closing the doors seems possible.
당시 가장 가벼운 260g의 Ti 카세트 리어 허브와 트래커 프론트 허브: The 260g Ti Cassette rear hub, the lightest of its day, and the Tracker front hub. The roots of today's hubs.
The ENO freewheel and eccentric hub ride the single speed boom and save the company.
Headsets led by Alec are released. The Radavist visits the Petaluma shop.
Acquires the Oregon wheel brands Rolf Prima and Astral Cycling.
